aboutText: NOVA Cabinets has been delivering premium custom joinery solutions to homes and businesses across Melbourne for over 15 years. Our team of skilled joiners and cabinet makers operate from our Brunswick workshop, creating bespoke kitchens, bathroom vanities, furniture, and architectural timber work that stands the test of time. Every piece we craft is designed in close collaboration with our clients, ensuring a result that's uniquely yours.

servicesSubheading: End-to-end joinery solutions for every room in your home
servicesText: From the initial design consultation through to final installation, we handle every aspect of your custom joinery project with meticulous care and attention to detail.

services.title: Custom Joinery Design
services.desc: Collaborative design sessions to create one-of-a-kind joinery that suits your space, style, and budget. We provide detailed 3D renders before a single cut is made.

services.title: Custom Joinery Installation
services.desc: Precision installation by our experienced team ensures every panel, drawer, and hinge fits perfectly. We treat your home like our own.

services.title: Kitchen Design & Installation
services.desc: Complete kitchen joinery from benchtops to pantry storage. We design and build kitchens that are as functional as they are beautiful.

services.title: Bathroom Joinery
services.desc: Custom vanities, mirrored cabinets, and storage solutions crafted from moisture-resistant materials to handle Melbourne's changing climate.

services.title: Furniture Joinery
services.desc: Bespoke entertainment units, bookshelves, desks, and wardrobes built to exact dimensions using premium Australian and imported timbers.

services.title: Cladding & Flooring
services.desc: Timber wall cladding and engineered flooring installation that adds warmth and character to any residential or commercial space.

testimonials.text: Absolutely thrilled with our new kitchen! The team at NOVA Cabinets took the time to understand exactly what we wanted and delivered something even better. The soft-close drawers and custom spice rack are brilliant. Couldn't recommend them more highly.
testimonials.name: Jack Patterson

testimonials.text: We had NOVA build custom wardrobes and an entertainment unit for our new townhouse in South Yarra. The craftsmanship is outstanding — you can tell these guys genuinely love what they do. Everything was delivered on time and the install was spotless.
testimonials.name: Emily Thornton

testimonials.text: After getting quotes from several joinery companies in Melbourne, we went with NOVA and are so glad we did. They helped us design a bathroom vanity that fits our space perfectly, and the quality of the timber work is leagues ahead of anything we saw elsewhere.
testimonials.name: David Nguyen
